title: .compile-state.json
description: Written only by the refresh workflow. Carries what OpenWiki's own state files do not: the claims delta, workflow provenance, and attempt count. additionalProperties is false so a field duplicated from .last-update.json or .page-manifest.json fails validation (C3).

compiled_from.description: Mirrored from openwiki/.last-update.json:gitHead. The workflow asserts equality before writing.

status.description: complete = converged. interrupted = OpenWiki's own status for a partially merged, safely retryable run. failed = exited non-zero before writing .last-update.json; compiled output may not exist.

claims.description: Computed by set arithmetic over sidecar claim ids before and after the run. Never parsed from stdout. Claim ids are stable across regeneration: measured 234 of 242 ids carried unchanged (97%) across two forced full rebuilds of an unchanged corpus, so `carried` is a real signal.

compile_mode.description: Which mode compiled this: deep (terra/high), normal (terra/medium), fast (gpt-5.4-mini/low). Read from the head commit's Compile-Mode trailer, else the dispatch input, else the repo default. Optional: state files written before the mode existed lack it.

changed_sources.description: Source paths whose bytes differed between this compiled_from and the previous one. Drives the UI's 'what triggered this' line.
